notes.title: Now Available - OVO Smash!
notes.content:
Do you have a good memory? Do you like humiliating your friends in local multiplayer?

Then OVO Smash is the game for you! 

Take control of the OVOs, a race of space eggs and engage in fierce mnemonic combat. Find memory matches of your opponents' colors to damage them! Last OVO standing wins!

Multiplayer Features: 

Up to 6 player local multiplayer modes
Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch: Find matches of your opponents' colors to damage them
Heat-Me-Up and Team Heat-Me-Up: Find matches of your own color to heat up. First to heat up wins


Single Player Features:

Score challenges: discover what's on the board then get the highest combo possible! You're going nowhere without a good long term memory
Timed challenges: race against the clock to clear the board. Speed and short term memory are necessary
Move challenges: clear the board with the least moves possible. Accuracy and medium term memory are essential
Get medals in challenges to unlock achievements + random accessories and patterns for your eggs
32 random accessories and 16 random patterns to unlock
